in_marathi.name: Akrur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skilled in war, destroyer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akrur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akrur is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'akrura', which means 'skilled in war' or 'destroyer'. This name is associated with the legendary figure Akrura, who appears in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. Akrura is a wise and compassionate character who plays a significant role in the events leading up to the great battle of Kurukshetra.
